breaking.member: font import setting chars (a font .ogt's font block and a .riv import's font <name> block)
breaking.change: chars only checked a face for the characters it listed, a check left from the atlas, which drew only the characters cooked into it. A face now ships whole and any character it has draws, and a character it lacks falls back through the chain, so the cook refuses a chars line. A .riv's font still notes the characters its own runs show that the face lacks.
breaking.fix: Delete the line (og upgrade does). To see which characters a text draws from which face, read the probe's missing-glyph warnings.
